persistent-boot.note: Load the RAM bootstrap over USB for every Linux boot.

local-console.note: 240×320 graphical terminal with physical keypad, multi-tap typing, menus, Help, scrollback and one-shot modifier combinations.

lcd-backlight.note: System levels 0…10; level 0 turns the light off. Visible step spacing is unqualified.

keypad-backlight.note: Lights on key presses and turns off after five seconds, including after wake.

image-rotation-engine.note: The ROTA device is disabled; use the application's CPU engine.

jpeg-engine.note: Native-size encoding, horizontal 4:2:2 half-resolution decoding and fixed half-scaling are available.

native-image-output.note: RGB565 and native NV16 presentation; color accuracy is unqualified.

jpeg-codec-and-scaling.note: Available within the qualified sizes and operations above.

native-image-presentation.note: RGB565 and native NV16 presentation; color accuracy is unqualified.

removable-storage.note: SDHC FAT32 and ext4 read/write in the RAM profile; insert the card before boot and keep it installed throughout the powered session. Hot-swap is not supported.

removable-system-root.note: Only the RAM root is available.

internal-phone-storage.note: Read-only raw NAND backup; no filesystem, writes or restore.

headphone-audio.note: Stereo PCM and per-channel mute with three-contact TRS headphones; jack detection works, but automatic output routing is not supported. TRRS compatibility is unqualified.

speaker-audio.note: PCM playback through the built-in speaker.

phone-microphone.note: Built-in microphone recording and replay, mono S16_LE at 48 kHz and duplex capture; acoustic response and headset input are unqualified.

fm-radio.note: Seeking, tuning and headphone reception in the RAM profile, with or without the battery installed; speaker, stereo output and sensitivity are unqualified.

bluetooth.note: Pairing, OPP, PAN and SBC A2DP source with a Linux PC; physical headsets and HID are unqualified.

wi-fi.stockNote: Stock Wi-Fi is listed as unavailable; physical radio presence remains unknown.

camera.note: BF3A01; native 240×320 NV16, sensor rotation 270° and adjustable brightness. Brightness levels 0–6, initially 3, may change during capture and survive stream stops. Color accuracy and concurrent capture/codec use are unqualified.

charger-status.note: USB input detection; battery charging is unqualified.

auxiliary-adc.note: Raw readings are available; channel calibration is unqualified.

real-time-clock.note: Read/write and alarm wake from s2idle; battery retention is unqualified.

other-battery-functions.note: No battery level, battery temperature or charge-control interface is provided.

vibration.stockNote: The stock phone provides vibration alerts; the actuator type is unconfirmed.

suspend.note: USB-powered s2idle with RTC or red-handset wake restores the display and USB session; mounted ext4 storage remains usable after RTC wake.

brightness-control.note: Application support has not been established on this phone.

tyrquake.note: Game data can use RAM or ext4 microSD storage; phone gameplay controls are supported.

built-in-microphone.note: Built-in microphone recording and replay, mono S16_LE at 48 kHz and duplex capture; acoustic response is unqualified.

headset-microphone.note: Headset input is implemented; physical recording is untested.

automatic-audio-routing.note: Automatic playback routing is not included in this phone's image.

bluetooth-file-transfer.note: OPP file transfer in the RAM profile.

bluetooth-pan-internet.note: PAN Internet in the RAM profile.

bluetooth-a2dp-linux-pc.note: SBC playback to a Linux PC sink in the RAM profile; reconnect is supported.

bluetooth-a2dp-headsets.note: Physical Bluetooth headsets have not been tested.

bluetooth-keyboard.note: Physical Bluetooth keyboard input has not been tested.

bluetooth-mouse.note: Physical Bluetooth mouse input has not been tested.

mobile-calls.note: Calls have no supported FPLinux path.

sms.note: SMS has no supported FPLinux path.

mobile-data.note: Mobile data has no supported FPLinux path.

ffmpeg.note: Optional CPU MPEG-4 Part 2, H.263 and H.264 decoding; device use is untested.

microsd-hot-swap.note: Insert the card before boot and keep it installed throughout the powered session.

sim-hot-swap.note: FPLinux has no supported cellular or SIM service path.

infrared-transmitter.note: FPLinux provides no infrared remote-control path.

gpu-rendering.note: No FPLinux GPU rendering path on this phone.
